title: Geshur
sourceLines: -District east of the sources of the Jordan River. The inhabitants of, not subdued by the Israelites De 3:14; Jos 13:2-13; 1Ch 2:23
-Inhabitants of one of the villages of, exterminated, and the spoils taken by David 1Sa 27:8
-Absalom takes refuge in, after the murder of Amnon 2Sa 1:3
